action_items: Backend suite ran successfully but contains no test files; this iteration had no API-bearing acceptance criteria.

checks.criterion: Home dashboard loads as the Learn Beyond Big Data Analytics foundation
checks.name: home-dashboard-loads
checks.evidence: Home rendered with hero title, Start learning and Explore 3D lab actions, subject stats, and primary navigation.

checks.criterion: Home Start learning opens the VTU subject overview
checks.name: start-learning-subject-overview
checks.evidence: Start learning navigated to Big Data Analytics subject page with metrics and module cards 01 through 05.

checks.criterion: VTU syllabus modules and topic filtering are usable
checks.name: subject-filter-modules
checks.evidence: HDFS filter retained Module 02; non-matching filter displayed the friendly empty state.

checks.criterion: A module opens into a navigable learning workspace
checks.name: module-workspace-tabs
checks.evidence: Module 02 opened with Hadoop Architecture & MapReduce title, module rail, progress, and workspace.

checks.criterion: Learning tabs switch content without dead ends
checks.name: module-workspace-tabs
checks.evidence: Learn, Explore, Practice, and Code tabs each rendered their panel; Explore showed Phase 3 and Practice/Code content was present.

checks.criterion: Global syllabus search routes to a relevant module
checks.name: global-search-routes-topic
checks.evidence: HDFS result appeared, opened Hadoop Architecture & MapReduce, and clear removed search results.

checks.criterion: Theme and responsive navigation controls work
checks.name: theme-and-mobile-navigation
checks.evidence: Theme class toggled; 390px viewport menu opened and Progress navigation rendered a feature preview.

checks.name: future-feature-previews-connected
checks.evidence: Lab, Gesture, Progress, and Settings sidebar links each rendered a connected feature preview card and checklist.
